name: @thunderclap/host-capacitor
description: ThunderClap's Capacitor host: createCapacitorHost() fills the engine's Host interface from Capacitor's plugins for an iOS or Android store app. It knows nothing about any game and has no dependencies; the @capacitor/* plugins are the app's own (not declared here: pnpm would try to install them), handed in through the plugins option.
author: ThunderClap

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
